lines.beaver: 박사님, 이번 폐수 유출 사고를 어떻게 보십니까?
lines.beaver_en: Doctor, what do you think of this wastewater leak?
lines.beaver_roman: baksanim, ibeon pyesu yuchul sagoreul eotteoke bosimnikka?
lines.learner: 참담하기 그지없습니다. 강이 죽어 가고 있습니다.
lines.en: It's utterly tragic. The river is dying.
lines.roman: chamdamhagi geujieopseumnida. gangi jugeo gago itseumnida.

lines.en: The water quality got much worse because of the wastewater.

lines.beaver_en: Does it affect the river's ecosystem too?
lines.en: Yes, the ecosystem has collapsed. It's extremely sad.

lines.learner: 복구는 가능하지만 몇 년은 걸릴 겁니다.
lines.en: Restoration is possible, but it will take years.
lines.roman: bokguneun ganeunghajiman myeon nyeoneun geollil geomnida.

lines.learner: 공장이 안전 관리를 소홀히 했기 때문입니다.
lines.en: Because the factory neglected safety management.
lines.roman: gongjangi anjeon gwallireul soholhi haetgi ttaemunimnida.

lines.learner: 규제를 강화하고 세부 기준을 만들어야 합니다.
lines.en: We must strengthen rules and make detailed standards.
lines.roman: gyujereul ganghwahago sebu gijuneul mandeureoya hamnida.

lines.beaver: 환경 문제에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell us more about environmental issues?
lines.beaver_roman: hwangyeong munjee daehae deo malsseumhae jusigetseumnikka?
lines.learner: 봄마다 오는 황사도 심각성이 커지고 있습니다.
lines.en: The yellow dust every spring is also getting more serious.
lines.roman: bommada oneun hwangsado simgakseongi keojigo itseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Many people also worry about nuclear power plants.
lines.learner: 네, 원자력도 사고가 나면 피해가 큽니다.
lines.en: Yes, nuclear accidents also cause huge damage.
lines.roman: ne, wonjaryeokdo sagoga namyeon pihaega keumnida.

lines.learner: 가급적 친환경 제품을 써 주시기를 호소합니다.
lines.en: I urge everyone to use eco-friendly products whenever possible.
lines.roman: gageupjeok chinhwangyeong jepumeul sseo jusigireul hosohamnida.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you sincerely for your words today, Doctor.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 이 강이 진정 다시 살아나길 바랍니다.
lines.en: Thank you. I truly hope this river comes back to life.
lines.roman: gamsahamnida. i gangi jinjeong dasi saranagil baramnida.
